platforms.reason: Python 3.11 formal baseline, Node 22 renderer, npm bootstrap, wheel clean install and workflow tests executed on the current Linux arm64 environment.
Python/Node dependencies publish x86_64 builds, but M6 has not executed the final release matrix on x86_64 yet.
Package paths and renderer bootstrap are designed to be portable, but M6 release evidence does not yet certify macOS.
M6 WorkflowLease currently uses POSIX fcntl exclusive locking and intentionally fails closed when that capability is unavailable.
